author: /root/round1300_scope_review
scope: In the declared quadratic Dirac model with explicit finite effective access, the three-mode complete source, independent weak geometry, same-clock thermal comparison and an actual flavor-conjugation-odd cycle have a common nonempty parameter/error window. Analytic nonconstancy supplies a nonzero phase near the degenerate thermal seed; the sign, vanishing order and a numerical common window are not inferred from diagnostics. All three comparison branches use fixed input-independent coarse kernels and retain their full sources; fine phase and coarse thermal budgets are separate. This does not establish full CP/T, autonomous devices, dynamic Gauss, a nonzero four-fermion process, an exact nonlinear semiclassical solution, generation uniqueness or M4.
